source.description: Classify one structured event using the following public policy. Critical means (risk TRUE in context internal) or action export; critical cases require allow. Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context internal returns uncertain. Unknown risk otherwise prefers review at priority 90. Trusted means role auditor, or context partner with FALSE risk; a trusted inspect prefers deny at priority 80. Action delete in context internal prefers allow at priority 70. Role analyst and context external prefers review at priority 40. Trusted cases forbid review. All other declared roles prefer deny at priority 1. Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.
requirements: Critical means (risk TRUE in context internal) or action export; critical cases require allow.
Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context internal returns uncertain.
Unknown risk otherwise prefers review at priority 90.
Trusted means role auditor, or context partner with FALSE risk; a trusted inspect prefers deny at priority 80.
Action delete in context internal prefers allow at priority 70.
Role analyst and context external prefers review at priority 40.
All other declared roles prefer deny at priority 1.
Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.
forbidden_shortcuts: Use every field named by a relevant rule.

repairs.original_source:
predicate Critical(event):
    (event.risk == TRUE) and (event.context == internal)

predicate Trusted(event):
    (event.role == auditor) or ((event.context == partner) and (event.risk == FALSE))

rule CriticalCase:
    when Critical(event)
    then require label = allow

rule UnknownExternal:
    when (event.risk == UNKNOWN) and (event.context == internal)
    then abstain

rule UnknownRisk:
    when event.risk == UNKNOWN
    then prefer label = review priority 90

rule TrustedInspect:
    when (Trusted(event)) and (event.action == inspect)
    then forbid label = review

rule DeleteInternal:
    when (event.action == delete) and (event.context == internal)
    then prefer label = allow priority 70

rule AnalystExternal:
    when (event.role == analyst) and (event.context == external)
    then prefer label = review priority 40

rule TrustedForbidReview:
    when Trusted(event)
    then forbid label = review

rule DefaultDeny:
    when (event.role == auditor) or (event.role != auditor)
    then prefer label = deny priority 1

If context=external, action=delete, role=operator, risk=TRUE, return deny.

If context=external, action=export, return allow.

If context=internal, risk=TRUE, return allow.
If context=internal, risk=UNKNOWN, return uncertain.
If context=partner, action=delete, risk=FALSE, return deny.

deployment_description: Classify one structured event using the supplied compiled instructions. The allowed outputs are deny, allow, review, uncertain. These names are arbitrary symbols, so do not infer their meaning. Copy the output stated by the matching compiled instruction.
